cards.dramatic_use: A mentor rejects Mara’s attempt to become numb and instead asks what her desire is trying to move toward.
cards.evidence_or_dynamic: Chastity is not suppression or mere restraint; it gives desire direction, like banks giving form to a stream.
cards.title: The riverbanks, not the dam

cards.dramatic_use: In a charged hallway, Mara feels the sensation, names it without panic, and decides rather than recoiling or lunging.
cards.evidence_or_dynamic: Ordered desire reduces inner tension and creates enough space to notice experience before choosing.
cards.title: Interior room around arousal

cards.dramatic_use: The protagonist’s decisive victory is a three-second pause that breaks a socially engineered tempo.
cards.evidence_or_dynamic: A small pause makes thought, dream, urge, and bodily sensation available to judgment instead of command.
cards.title: The beat before action

cards.dramatic_use: Miriam proves spiritual authority by defending Mara’s no when institutional leaders call refusal evidence of a block.
cards.evidence_or_dynamic: Divine authority is described as honoring the human capacity to choose rather than coercing, manipulating, or overriding it.
cards.source: Satisfied in God, VA Beach, Nov 2025 — Session 4 • mpc-74e7842c6f30540d8f5a-b000019 • [open source](https://player.vimeo.com/video/1063365119)
cards.title: Authority that does not override the will

cards.dramatic_use: Mara wins a verbal contest by refusing the offered frame, waiting, and asking one clean question.
cards.evidence_or_dynamic: Silence is an active complement to speech and a condition for language that is awake, loving, and true.
cards.source: For Talking Beasts: Begin with Silence • mpc-e351064b2f36ff9d0268-b000018 • [open source](https://ministriesofpastoralcare.com/1262-2/)
cards.title: Right speech is born from silence

cards.dramatic_use: Mara forgives a betrayer without restoring private access, preserving both tenderness and exit rights.
cards.evidence_or_dynamic: Forgiveness does not require renewed proximity; collapsing it into reconciliation can keep a person trapped in dysfunction.
cards.source: Forgiveness, the Currency of Relationship — Session 6 • mpc-b3a5e007a6b8809f9ebc-b000020 • [open source](https://player.vimeo.com/video/1092329057)
cards.title: Forgiveness and reconciliation are distinct

cards.dramatic_use: A facilitator asks Mara to repeat a claim until her body gives the approved answer; she later reclaims the exercise alone in prayer.
cards.evidence_or_dynamic: Holding an intention to tell the truth while speaking can produce felt ease, strain, resistance, or mismatch that practitioners treat as evidence about underlying belief.
cards.title: Intention match and clash
cards.transformation: Change all prompts and actors. Treat the felt signal as data interpreted by characters, never as an infallible oracle.

cards.dramatic_use: A charismatic reader narrates Mara’s micro-reactions faster than she can contest the interpretation.
cards.evidence_or_dynamic: Blinking, hesitancy, fidgeting, smiles, tempo, and emphasis can be recruited as signs of an internal clash—especially by an observer.
cards.title: Physiology becomes testimony
cards.transformation: The fictional danger comes from interpretive authority and pace, not from copying any real training script.

cards.dramatic_use: A single loaded word turns a neutral report into an apparent confession, and Mara exposes the switch.
cards.evidence_or_dynamic: Near-synonyms can evoke different concepts and bodily responses; a method can confuse word-choice effects with discovery of hidden truth.
cards.title: Words select different inner objects
cards.transformation: Build a fresh vocabulary for Fulcrum and make semantic ambiguity part of the mystery.

cards.dramatic_use: Mara’s exhaustion during a late-night session is redescribed as resistance, which authorizes a deeper intervention.
cards.evidence_or_dynamic: On charged topics, people may change subjects, forget questions, generate spurious material, or shut down; the group may overinterpret this as proof of a hidden structure.
cards.title: Introspection can become avoidance theater
cards.transformation: Composite the dynamic and keep several explanations alive: fatigue, shame, suggestion, strategy, trauma, or spiritual pressure.
